scope.denominator: Only emitted runtime dependency-closure sources observed by the child; test/self-check and missing modules excluded from aggregate denominators, retained as explicit evidence.

exclusions.policy: Node internals, dependencies, harness, test/self-check sources and non-emitted application modules excluded from aggregate; test and unmapped evidence retained per module.

branchCoverage.reason: V8 block ranges are not a conventional source branch census.

limitations: One child, one compilation. Each exact runtime URL is mapped independently against its captured JS/map/source hashes; generated offsets are never combined between modules or compilations.
Source lines are mapped observed executable spans, not an AST census. Functions use observed V8 first-range hits; unmapped functions remain excluded. No whole-repository or 80% acceptance claim.
